notes.title: Base Game & DLC merge
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Enhancing the game's maintenance for easier management.
[*] Merge and improve trailers, screenshots, and information onto a single store page.
[*] Each case is already designed as a stand-alone experience, so this would allow players to choose their preferred order without requiring additional DLC purchases.
[/list]

[i]All your achievements and saved data are already stored within the base game.
Instead of separate add-on DLCs, all DLC content will be seamlessly integrated into the base game.
These changes will be implemented in the near future(4th December), accompanied by a price update for the base game to reflect these changes. [/i]

Thank you for your support~
